definitions.explanation: A prediction or expectation about how things will develop in the future.
The ability to see clearly into the distance without obstruction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見通|みとお}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧。
⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見通|みとお}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}たない→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: There's no clear outlook for the future.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年度|らいねんど}→来年度：28221_rainendo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}{成長|せいちょう}→経済成長：20453_keizaiseichou⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{楽観的|らっかんてき}→楽観的：06090_rakkanteki⟧な{見通|みとお}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: The government presented an optimistic outlook for next fiscal year's economic growth.

examples.japanese: {見通|みとお}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦カーブ→カーブ：27529_kaabu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful at curves with poor visibility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{見通|みとお}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧になった。
examples.english: Visibility worsened due to fog, making driving dangerous.

notes:
WRITING:
⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧ (see) + {通|とお}し (through). Literally "seeing through."

USAGE:
{見通|みとお}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (an outlook is established) and {見通|みとお}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}たない→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (no clear outlook) are extremely common patterns in news and business contexts. For sense 2, {見通|みとお}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (good/poor visibility) is standard in traffic and weather reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見通|みとお}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: an outlook is formed
- {見通|みとお}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧/⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧: the outlook is dim/bright
- {見通|みとお}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to present a forecast
- {見通|みとお}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧: an overly optimistic forecast
